subject.title: fix(gateway): pass media localRoots to sendDurableMessageBatch for gateway-mode sends

question: Should Gateway-mode `message send --media` now reject existing out-of-root local paths so it matches the configured local-media allowlist used by direct-mode sends?
rationale: The patch is technically narrow and proof-backed, but the resulting failure for previously successful operator workflows is an intentional security and upgrade-policy decision rather than a mechanical code question.

options.title: Accept consistent allowlist enforcement
options.body: Merge the repair and treat out-of-root Gateway-mode media sends as unsupported, matching the direct-mode boundary.

options.title: Preserve legacy Gateway permissiveness
options.body: Do not merge this behavior change unless maintainers choose a separately designed compatibility or migration policy.

recommendation.title: Accept consistent allowlist enforcement
recommendation.body: Merge the repair and treat out-of-root Gateway-mode media sends as unsupported, matching the direct-mode boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history places this contributor on the Gateway send and attachment-materialization path that the PR extends.
